notes: All names, tax identifiers, purchase orders and invoice details are synthetic test data.
Process happy_path_invoice.pdf before duplicate_invoice.pdf so the duplicate business key exists in history.
Process split_invoice_1.pdf before split_invoice_2.pdf; the second invoice consumes the remaining PO balance.
PO amounts are pre-tax. Invoice net amount is subtotal + shipping - discount.
The 2% tolerance applies to comparable line-item unit prices; it does not permit exceeding the remaining PO balance.
